Speaking on 'Strategic Culture of India and National Security' at SCNSS, JNU on November 3, former CDS General Anil Chauhan (Retd.) said, "No power can threaten the frontiers of a nation whose citizens are aware and informed. National security is about alertness, awareness and action. National security cannot remain a subject confined to the armed forces and govt officials. In a democracy, the people shape the climate in which the govt takes decisions."
